sources.title: AtomicChat/Clover-35B-A3B-Preview-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview is DiffuSpace's block-diffusion language model: a 35B mixture-of-experts with about 3B active parameters per token, derived from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, 128K context, thinking on by default, Apache-2.0. Built by the team behind Atomic Chat, the app that runs open-weight models locally and offline. Four plain llama.cpp files from 21.2 GB to 36.9 GB on disk, each measured against ...
